name: Accessibility Pack
author: Moritz Wallinger
description: Accessibility assists with an Enhanced RAC Style health display, warnings and damage protection.

settings.name: Normal-hit frequency
settings.description: 100 keeps every normal hit; 50 passes every second hit; 0 ignores normal hits.

settings.name: Lethal-hit protection
settings.description: At one health, ignore one normal hit, then wait three seconds before protection can trigger again.

settings.name: Ignore normal damage
settings.description: Ignore normal hits handled by the game's damage function. Instant-kill hazards are unchanged.

settings.name: Enhanced RAC health display
settings.description: Show Ratchet's health in a Ratchet & Clank-inspired tech panel.

settings.name: Health panel size
settings.description: Scale the Enhanced RAC Style health panel.

settings.name: Low-health warning
settings.description: Show an Enhanced RAC Style low-health warning banner at one health.
